notes.title: GOBSMACKED is Here!
notes.content:
Hey Goblins,

Today GOBSMACKED is moving from Early Access to 1.0. We've spent the last few months in EA refining almost every part of the game, listening to player feedback in our Discord and adding a brand new game mode: The Gauntlet.

The Gauntlet is part of the underground Gob-scene where you don't use currency to upgrade gear but the pace is much higher. Maximizing your reputation is the ultimate goal. The Gauntlet is available after you've achieved victory in The Arenas.

As we fully release the game today, we'd like to send extra thanks & hugs to everyone that helps us make Gobsmacked. Our collaborators, playtesters and players who've joined the Discord to share their thoughts and kind words about the game.

We hope you have as much fun playing GOBSMACKED as we had making this little game.

Hey Gobheads,

We've just added Portuguese support to GOBSMACKED so even more folks can enjoy the mayhem of The Arenas. 

Also in this update we've added some UI refinements and lowered the damage for some traps. 

Your goblin backstage arena crew (Ash & Adam) are cooking up new ways to cause chaos, so stay tuned...

notes.title: FOV & Fixes
notes.content:
Hey goblins, we're serving up a fresh demo update for ya'll. What's new:
[list]
[*] Added a FOV setting in Visuals. You can now adjust the goblin's field of view to your personal chaotic preference.
[*] Added signs to help newer gladiators find their way to the arena shop.
[*] Fixed a bug with some wrecks registering as "Throw Wreck" incorrectly.
[*] Fixed some crowd pleasers not working as expected.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Updated
notes.content:
Hey goblins, we've cooked up a demo update for your chaotic claws.

[list]
[*] Support for Chinese (simplified)
[*] Grabbing walls now required an explicit key press (hold Shift). This fixed getting unintentionally "stuck" to walls.
[*] Refined ledge jump, now only occurs if you're holding forward and press Jump near a ledge.
[*] The crowd is more eager to throw you health. 
[*] We've made the gold rush timer bigger, so it's easier for all goblin's eyeballs.
[*] We've fixed some issues with climbing through walls in the tutorial. 
[/list]

More from us soon... Happy goblin-ing!

notes.title: GOBSMACKED Demo
notes.content:
Hey goblin fan, The GOBSMACKED demo is now live on Steam!

Be a goblin, cause chaos, have a great time, wishlist the game, become super into it, make homemade t shirts, start selling them online, be excited that Ash & I are pumped because they look pretty good.

Many huge thanks if you check out the demo, wishlist, and/or follow. We're doing this classic indie style (out of pocket) so any support is VERY appreciated!
